name: langchain-taiga
summary: Python toolkit that lets your LangChain agents automate Taiga: create, search, edit & comment on user stories, tasks and issues via the official REST API. v2 introduces the multi-tenant remote MCP mode (HTTP+OAuth) alongside the existing stdio transport. v2.5+ adds OAuth refresh-token rotation and attachment tools; v2.13 persists OAuth state in Postgres so restarts no longer force re-login; v2.14 adds non-destructive tag editing; v2.19 adds token-lean reads (fields/compact) and a single-PATCH hand-over.
